svg.title: Learning curves for high variance and for high bias
svg.desc: Expected training and test error of least squares against the number of training examples, computed exactly. Left, a model with 20 features of which 5 matter: training error starts at zero and rises, test error falls, and the large gap between them closes as data are added, crossing the desired level at about 155 examples. Right, a model with 2 features when more are needed: both curves flatten out at the same level, above the desired error, so more data cannot reach it.
svg.text: High bias: 2 features, the rest omitted
dotted: the error neither curve can go below (noise, plus the omitted signal on the right)
